Peg Powler

River Tees water hag.
Her froth is Peg Powler’s suds.

Halloween
31.10.2026
WebGL

Moon now
 

Peg Powler lives on the Moon. Twice a day, the Moon pulls the tide in from the North Sea and up the Tees, as far as the Barrage at Stockton.

She rides it in. Things have been seen along the river ever since, and the reports are logged below.

Where Peg livesPhotographs: NASA
Sightings on TeessideAlong the tide · as reported locally
  1. 01Preston Hall, Preston ParkA grey lady, a highwayman, and a woman with a dog who vanishes through the wine cellar wall.54.54°N 1.34°W
  2. 02Green Dragon Yard, StocktonGhostly figures seen around the old inn.54.57°N 1.32°W
  3. 03Thornaby Snooker CentreAn airman in the former wartime officers’ mess.54.54°N 1.30°W
  4. 04Kiora Hall, RoseworthSaid to be haunted by a former owner, Lieutenant Trenchman.54.58°N 1.34°W
  5. 05Hartburn LodgeAn aircraft pilot seen on the upper floors.54.56°N 1.35°W
  6. 06Ketton Ox, YarmOne of Yarm High Street’s reputedly haunted pubs.54.51°N 1.35°W
  7. 07River TeesPeg Powler, the green-haired hag who drags children in. Her froth is Peg Powler’s suds.54.57°N 1.31°W

Sources: Gazette Live, “Most haunted places around Stockton”; Peg Powler from Tees folklore.
